manual.title: User Manual
manual.subtitle: Everything you need to know to effectively use Aticon for managing your architecture and construction projects
manual.welcomeDescription: Your complete platform for managing construction and architecture projects
manual.manageProjectsDescription: Create, organize, and track your construction and architecture projects from start to finish
manual.generateDocumentsDescription: Use professional templates to create consistent, high-quality project documents
manual.aiAssistantDescription: Get instant answers about building regulations and project requirements
manual.teamCollaborationDescription: Work together with your team members and manage permissions
manual.completeProfileDescription: Add your name and company information
manual.inviteTeamMembersDescription: Add colleagues to your company workspace
manual.createFirstProjectDescription: Set up a project to start organizing your work
manual.exploreTemplatesDescription: Browse available document templates for your projects
manual.projectManagementDescription: Create, organize, and track your construction and architecture projects
manual.creatingStep1: Navigate to the Dashboard and click 'Create New Project'
manual.creatingStep2: Enter project details: name, project address, client information
manual.creatingStep3: Set project start date and select the project stage
manual.creatingStep4: Assign a project leader from your team
manual.creatingStep5: Choose which document templates you'll need
manual.creatingStep6: Save the project to start working
manual.creatingTip: Choose templates carefully - you can always add more later, but it's easier to select them upfront.
manual.managingStep1: Use the Kanban board to track project stages: To Do, In Progress, Review, Done
manual.managingStep2: Update project status as work progresses
manual.managingStep3: Assign specific documents to team members
manual.managingStep4: Monitor deadlines and progress on the dashboard
manual.managingStep5: Archive completed projects to keep your workspace organized
manual.managingTip: Regular status updates help keep everyone on the same page and ensure deadlines are met.
manual.variablesStep1: Access project variables from the project detail page
manual.variablesStep2: Fill in general variables that apply to all documents (client name, address, etc.)
manual.variablesStep3: Set specific variables for individual templates
manual.variablesStep4: Use the 'General Variables' tab to manage shared information
manual.variablesStep5: Generate documents with pre-filled project information
manual.variablesTip: Setting up general variables saves time when generating multiple documents for the same project.
manual.documentTemplatesDescription: Professional templates for all your project documentation needs
manual.usingTemplatesStep1: Browse templates by category or search by name
manual.usingTemplatesStep2: Select a template that matches your project needs
manual.usingTemplatesStep3: Review the required variables and information needed
manual.usingTemplatesStep4: Fill in project-specific information in the variable fields
manual.usingTemplatesStep5: Generate the document and download or save to your project
manual.usingTemplatesStep6: Edit the generated document as needed for your specific requirements
manual.usingTemplatesTip: Templates are designed to be starting points - feel free to customize the generated documents for your specific needs.
manual.templateVariablesStep1: Each template has predefined variables (placeholders for information)
manual.templateVariablesStep2: Variables can be text, numbers, dates, or even images
manual.templateVariablesStep3: Some variables are marked as 'general' and can be shared across templates
manual.templateVariablesStep4: Fill in variables at the project level to speed up document generation
manual.templateVariablesStep5: Use the Enhanced Variables tab to see all variables across templates
manual.templateVariablesTip: Setting up project-level variables once saves time when generating multiple documents.
manual.aiAssistantPageDescription: Get instant answers about building regulations, project requirements, and uploaded documents
manual.smartSearchDescription: Ask questions in natural language and get relevant answers from your documents
manual.br18RegulationsDescription: Access Danish building regulations with instant explanations and references
manual.projectContextDescription: Get answers specific to your current projects and their requirements
manual.aiStep2: Type your question in natural language (e.g., 'What are the fire safety requirements for office buildings?')
manual.aiStep3: The AI will search through building regulations and your uploaded documents
manual.aiStep4: Review the answer and check the source references provided
manual.aiStep5: Click on source links to view the original documents
manual.aiStep6: Start a new chat for different topics or continue the conversation
manual.aiTip: Be specific in your questions for better results. Include context like building type, location, or specific requirements.
manual.exampleQ1: "What are the minimum ceiling heights for residential buildings?"
manual.exampleQ2: "Show me fire safety requirements for this project"
manual.exampleQ3: "What ventilation standards apply to office spaces?"
manual.uploadStep1: In the AI Assistant, click the upload button (paperclip icon)
manual.uploadStep2: Select PDF or Word documents from your computer
manual.uploadStep3: Choose whether files are temporary (deleted after session) or permanent
manual.uploadStep4: Wait for the documents to be processed and indexed
manual.uploadStep5: Ask questions about the uploaded content
manual.uploadStep6: Use 'New Chat' to remove temporary files and start fresh
manual.uploadTip: Upload project-specific documents to get more relevant answers about your particular requirements.
manual.teamManagementDescription: Collaborate effectively with your team members and manage permissions
manual.adminDescription: Full system access and company management
manual.projectManagerDescription: Lead projects and manage team assignments
manual.userDescription: Work on assigned projects and documents
manual.addTeamStep2: Click on 'Manage Colleagues' or 'Add Team Member'
manual.addTeamStep3: Enter the new member's email address and name
manual.addTeamStep4: Select their role (User, Project Manager, or Company Admin)
manual.addTeamStep5: Send the invitation - they'll receive an email to join
manual.addTeamStep6: Once they accept, they'll appear in your team list
manual.addTeamTip: Start with 'User' role and upgrade permissions as needed. You can always change roles later.
manual.assignStep1: Open a project and go to the 'Assignments' tab
manual.assignStep2: Assign specific documents to team members
manual.assignStep3: Set supervisors for quality control and review
manual.assignStep4: Monitor progress through the project dashboard
manual.assignStep5: Team members receive notifications about their assignments
manual.assignStep6: Track completion status and review submitted work
manual.assignTip: Clear assignments help ensure accountability and prevent work duplication.
manual.bestPractice1: Assign clear roles and responsibilities from the start
manual.bestPractice2: Use project leaders to coordinate team efforts
manual.bestPractice3: Regular check-ins help keep projects on track
manual.bestPractice4: Document assignments prevent confusion and overlap

manual.trainingResourcesDescription: Access additional training materials and video tutorials
